label: CAT12 BME280 HTTP
info:
Polls the STM32 HTTP server (CAT12B) every 5 s and builds a min/max/average table.
Edit the URL in the http request node to the IP printed on the STM32 debug UART.

name: 1) set the STM32 IP in 'GET STM32 /'   2) Deploy   3) watch the Debug sidebar
min / max / average
